# NotepadMac

> NotepadMac is an unofficial native macOS port of the Notepad++ text editor: a Cocoa application built from the same Scintilla editing engine and Lexilla syntax highlighting as Notepad++, reading Notepad++'s own language, style, theme, function-list, shortcut and translation files. It runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 11 or later, without Wine or emulation. Free and open source under the GNU GPL version 3.

Key facts: all 579 commands of the Windows menus are implemented; syntax highlighting for about 90 languages plus User Defined Languages; Boost regular expressions; all 46 Notepad++ character sets; Windows-format settings files (session.xml, shortcuts.xml, contextMenu.xml, UDL, themes) work unchanged. Windows plugins (.dll) cannot load; JSON, Compare, XML tools, FTP, NppExec-style scripting, MIME tools and Git (margin marks for changed lines, branch in the status bar, stage/unstage/discard/commit, Compare with HEAD, blame, history, branches, fetch/pull/push) are built in, and native Mac plugins can be written against a C plugin interface. Compare runs on the ComparePlus plugin's engine.

Numbers and formulas (Edit > Selected Numbers, Edit > Calculate; also in the context menu): a selected set of numbers (comma-, space- or semicolon-separated, one per line, or a column) gets Sum, Average, Minimum, Maximum and Count from the context menu's Selected Numbers, written after them as "SUM = 134", and can be sorted ascending or descending in place. Edit > Calculate (Cmd+=, also in the context menu) writes a formula's value after its "=": the selected formula, or the one typed before the caret ("2 + 3 * 4 =" gives "= 14"; without "=" it is added). Supported: + - * / : ^ mod ! %, parentheses, sin cos tan cot sec csc and inverses, sinh cosh tanh, sqrt cbrt exp ln log lg log2, log(x; base), root(x; n), pow, abs floor ceil round trunc sign, min max gcd lcm, pi e tau phi, degrees with °. Decimal arithmetic, ten decimal places, decimal comma accepted. An agent uses them over MCP: `go_to` with `line`/`column` (and `end_line`/`end_column` to select), then `run_command` with `Edit|Calculate` or `Edit|Selected Numbers|Sum` (Average, Minimum, Maximum, Count, Sort Ascending, Sort Descending); menu paths are English in every interface language. Not made, released or supported by the Notepad++ project; questions about the Mac version go to this repository's Issues and Discussions.

For AI agents: NotepadMac is itself an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, off by default (Preferences > MISC.); `nppmac mcp` bridges an agent's stdio to it (`claude mcp add notepadmac -- nppmac mcp`). Tools: open documents and unsaved text, selection, caret placement, edits with undo, bookmarks, any menu command, language detection, lexer tokens, function list, Notepad++'s regex search, Compare, character-set detection, OCR, QR, spell check.

Install: `brew install --cask tanderbold/tap/notepadmac`, or the notarised .dmg from the Releases page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tanderbold.github.io/NotepadMac/): overview, install, feature list
- [Numbers and formulas](https://tanderbold.github.io/NotepadMac/numbers.html): Selected Numbers (sum, average, min, max, count, sort) and Calculate (Cmd+=), with the full formula reference and the MCP calls
- [FAQ](https://tanderbold.github.io/NotepadMac/faq.html): installation, plugins, Windows settings, languages, AI agents (MCP), differences from NotepadNext
- [Source and README](https://github.com/tanderbold/NotepadMac): full feature description, build instructions
- [Feature list](https://github.com/tanderbold/NotepadMac/blob/main/macos/FEATURES.md): every menu command and its status
- [Plugin SDK](https://github.com/tanderbold/NotepadMac/blob/main/macos/plugin-sdk/README.md): writing native Mac plugins
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanderbold/NotepadMac/releases): signed and notarised downloads
- [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/tanderbold/homebrew-tap): the cask
